propositions: Code review currently ignores effective disables, project criteria activation, file applicability, and explicit budgets; the new adapter must compile selection from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and enforce these constraints.
Round A must select each built-in and project criterion exactly once, skip disabled/inapplicable criteria with stored reason, and execute project DET criteria outside the LLM fan-in.
After a local criterion call exhausts, later independent criteria must continue; successes persist; blocking-capable missing coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists.
Positive authored usd_budget must be enforced and shed units recorded before calls; zero stays schema-invalid; omission remains uncapped.
The authored code-review.yaml topology, base-reviewer payload, per-overlay context, model-ladder resolution, sequential scheduling, and absence of checkpoints must be preserved unchanged.
Internal discovery trace must persist in the code-review journal sidecar; shadow contract tests must report no differences outside the approved delta allowlist without duplicate model calls.
